sweep verb

also sweep the floor

classical

verrō, verrere

verb, third conjugation

Examples

  • Solum scōpīs verre.

    Sweep the floor with the broom.composed

  • pavīmentum verrere

    sweep the floorTraupman 38

See also broom, floor, dust.
